items.description: Exact names of talismans, crystal tears or great runes. Pass every item the user named at once, so the combined effect is a returned figure rather than one you work out.

assume.description: The items whose conditions you are asserting hold for the hit being asked about — 'Shard of Alexander' only if the hit is a weapon skill, 'Lord of Blood's Exultation' only after a bleed proc. Only these are multiplied into stacked_multiplier. Every item must also appear in `items`.

pvp.description: Use the PvP figure where the description gives a separate one. Default false.
